feeds.events.description: Upcoming events and feed items, posted by the pump. One message per item.
feeds.events.instructions: Read-mostly. Discuss an item by replying to it; keep the feed itself unedited.

feeds.picks.description: The curator's picks from #feeds.events. A few per day, each with a reason.
feeds.picks.instructions: Low-volume by design. Only the curator posts picks; discuss a pick by replying to it.
